//: Artifact → destination mapping for `bun run deploy`. No repo paths are hardcoded: each target is built from a named root you pass at deploy time (e.g. --wwwroot / --tools / --content-root) or set via env. A target copies `from` (a build artifact, relative to the monorepo) into `<root>/<into>`. Enable/disable per target with `enabled`.

targets.name: bundler
targets.comment: Parcel bundler output → static files served at /sandpack-bundler/ (index.html no-cache, hashed chunks immutable).

targets.name: cdn
targets.comment: Rust sidecar binary (sandpack-cdn[.exe]) → the host's Tools dir; spawned as a reverse-proxied process at /sandpack-cdn/.
